scientific_accounts.closing_remarks: The synthetic path illustrates a candidate gap connection built from atomic observations. Biological conclusions require actual captured support.
scientific_accounts.context: Synthetic authoring example; every observation is fictional and ineligible for research citation. Evidence need: observations linking the selected factor, its genes and gene sets, its own trait and other linked traits to the selected gap. One atomic Claim per evidence family, then one gap-relevance synthesis citing them. Known GeneSet provenance reaches the synthetic capture File; original experimental construction is unspecified.

claims.statement: The synthetic loading capture records this observation; a loading is a fitted weight, not a probability.
The synthetic PIGEAN capture records this association; the scores are not probabilities.
The synthetic membership capture records this member of the trusted gene set.
The synthetic projection capture records this joint loading; a projection is a fitted weight, not a phenotype association.
The synthetic release gene-set beta capture records this association; the effect is a model estimate, not a causal effect.
The synthetic factor-trait link capture records this link to a trait other than the factor's own; the q-value is over every factor-trait test.
The six synthetic atomic observations share one GENEX, SYNTHETIC_SET and SyntheticFactor1 path; together they motivate a candidate gap connection, not a causal conclusion.

Exact synthetic uncorrected gene-set effect estimate from release PIGEAN betas mode; not a BioIndex small-model value.
